assertions.assertion: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of palpitations and lightheadedness consistent with supraventricular tachycardia and sick sinus syndrome
occurring against a background of known atherosclerotic heart disease
a cardiac event monitoring study (CPT 93271) is required to correlate clinical events with rhythm disturbances
the payer has denied it under Reason Code CO-97
indicating the service is bundled into another covered procedure
The diagnosis codes on the claim are I47.1, I25.10, and I49.5
